messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2998765432 — Automated alert: spike in prefix-KV correctness errors and 5xxs starting ~12:43 UTC. Paging oncall: @mike-oncall. See telemetry: https://metrics.redwood/internal/alerts/2998765432

mike-oncall: I’m paged in, joining. what's the immediate signal?

oliver: error rate + correctness guard trips on prefix reads. traces show a large number of cache evictions around shard-7 -> downstream 5xx and fallback to cold model.

erin: confirmed. We had a shard restart during autoscaling; prefetch workers re-populated aggressively and caused eviction churn. Heatmap: https://obs.redwood/internal/hmaps/evict-shard7

carla: any customer-facing impact yet?

raj: support seeing ~3 customers with elevated latency & degraded outputs. Tickets: #4521, #4523, #4527. Customers reporting intermittent failures and longer tails.

dave: Recommend immediate live mitigations: 1) disable prefix prefetch globally for short interval, 2) apply tenant-specific read QPS carveouts for the impacted tenants, 3) enable pass-through mode for their cache to preserve correctness.

oliver: running commands now — will post exact commands.

oliver: ```
# disable global prefetch (5m)
redwoodctl cache set-prefetch --enabled=false --scope=global --ttl=5m --reason=\"eviction-storm-shard7\"
# throttle affected tenants to limit cache storming
redwoodctl traffic adjust --tenant tenant-4521 --read-qps=3
redwoodctl traffic adjust --tenant tenant-4523 --read-qps=3
redwoodctl traffic adjust --tenant tenant-4527 --read-qps=3
```

incident-bot: Command accepted: cache.prefetch -> disabled (rolling), traffic.adjust jobs queued (3 tenants).

mike-oncall: I’ll take ownership. @dave please also set pass-through for those tenants so we bypass prefix reads while we stabilize. enable shadow reads so we can validate correctness without impacting customers.

dave: Applied pass-through + shadow for tenants:
```
redwoodctl cache mode --tenant tenant-4521 --mode=pass-through --shadow=true
redwoodctl cache mode --tenant tenant-4523 --mode=pass-through --shadow=true
redwoodctl cache mode --tenant tenant-4527 --mode=pass-through --shadow=true
```

erin: Putting a short canary rollback for prefetch scheduler (PR #7890) to reduce aggressiveness if mitigations don't bring tail down. Deploy window ~3m.

carla: I'll prepare comms. Draft to impacted customers: \"We’ve applied targeted mitigations to reduce errors and restore stability; we expect progressive improvement in the next 30-45 minutes.\" @raj please send and log responses.

raj: Sending now. Template note: impact=intermittent failures & higher latency; mitigation=disabled prefetch + tenant carveouts; eta=30-45m. Will update tickets. :thumbsup:

oliver: Metrics update: error_rate (prefix reads) down ~30% in the last 60s, overall 5xx rate falling but p50/p99 tail still elevated. Keeping prefetch off and quotas tight while we watch.

mike-oncall: Handoff plan — leaving to night oncall @gina at 13:30 UTC. Summary for handoff: eviction storm originated from shard-7 autoscale -> aggressive prefetch caused evictions -> correctness guards tripped. Actions taken: disabled prefetch globally (5m window), set tenant read QPS to 3 then to 2 if needed, enabled pass-through+shadow for impacted tenants, PR #7890 in flight to soften prefetch schedule. Still monitoring; do not re-enable prefetch without SRE signoff.

gina: Taking over, ack. I’ll watch telemetry and customer tickets; will escalate if any regression.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 2998765432 status=mitigated (live mitigations active). Next auto-check in 15m.
